collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — GOOD, BAD AND ORDINARY DAYS (DAY-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Wonderful days, rotten days, mixed days and days when nothing much happens at all. Moods come without reasons, small things matter more than they should, and nobody has to end the day happier, wiser or more productive than they started it.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an adult)

collection.description: A villager has badly overslept and the whole day has started wrong: rush to catch up, or accept a late start.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (name1) has overslept. Badly. The sun is high. Everyone is already at work. (He/she) dresses in a rush, runs out of the hut, trips over the doorstep, and arrives at work flustered and hungry. The whole day has started wrong, and it feels as if the rest of it will be one step behind.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (name1) decides that (he/she) is late, and that's that. (He/she) eats breakfast first, slowly. Then (he/she) works at an ordinary pace and gets an ordinary amount done. Nobody says anything. The world doesn't end. The whole day is just shifted a little later than usual, like a hut that's been moved a few steps along the path.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: (name1) works twice as fast all morning to catch up. (He/she) does catch up, mostly. (He/she) also drops things, forgets things and puts things in the wrong place. By evening, (he/she) is exhausted and everything is done, roughly. It has felt like a day spent chasing (him/her)self.
